routes.name: Lantzas 1577 — Corfu → Ragusa

routes.name: Lantzas Book II — Naples → Himara

routes.name: Lantzas Book II — Otranto → Naples

routes.name: Lantzas Book I — Merlere → Corfu

routes.name: Lantzas Book II — Himara → Sopot

routes.name: Lantzas Book II — Sopot → Himara
